title: Gemini derives an exact analytic solution for the cosmic-string gravitational-radiation power integral
summary: A Gemini Deep Think system, guided by tree search and numerical feedback, derived closed-form spectral coefficients for the integral determining gravitational radiation power from cosmic-string loops, resolving the paper’s stated open calculation. The authors compare the expressions against direct numerical integration over ranges of loop harmonic and geometry parameters, finding close agreement. This is a theoretical/computational result, not a new astronomical detection.
ai_technology: Google Gemini Deep Think integrated with tree search, executable Python evaluation and high-precision numerical feedback
organization: Affiliations are not recorded as an organization claim because the consulted arXiv page did not expose them in the checked abstract.

evidence.tested: A Gemini Deep Think system, guided by tree search and numerical feedback, derived closed-form spectral coefficients for the integral determining gravitational radiation power from cosmic-string loops, resolving the paper’s stated open calculation.
evidence.unknown: The source is an unrefereed arXiv preprint. The paper provides derivations and numerical cross-checks, not proof-assistant verification or independent replication. The first recurrence attempt contained an error that the later Gemini-assisted review corrected. The claim is limited to the stated integral for the cosmic-string radiation model and its exact analytic evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Gemini generated and refined analytical approaches inside a tree-search workflow whose Python harness compared candidate expressions with high-precision numerical integration. A later human-initiated session with a more advanced Gemini model identified a recurrence error and telescoped the series into a finite analytic expression; this was a human–AI handoff, not a fully autonomous end-to-end result.
